findings.title: Metric alert handler is abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` inherits the abstract methods of `StatefulDetectorHandler` but implements none of them. Because `MetricAlertFire` registers this class as its detector handler, `Detector.detector_handler` will raise `TypeError` when it tries to instantiate a detector of this type, preventing that detector from being processed.

findings.title: Evaluation docstring still promises a list
findings.body: This method now returns a dictionary keyed by group key, but its docstring says it returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`. That contradicts the method’s return contract and can mislead callers implementing or using detector handlers.
